Hong Kong Techathon+

Prompt the Future: Build with AI at Hong Kong Techathon+ 11th Edition

Since 2015, we’ve been the ultimate cross-university launchpad, fueling over 9000 students and 2800 innovative ideas.

Hey young techies, ready to ship something epic? In 2026, AI isn't just a tool; it's your ultimate co-founder. Whether you're building next-gen agents or leveraging generative AI to disrupt the status quo, Hong Kong Techathon+ is calling you to turn those massive ideas into reality.

Co-hosted by HKSTP and 15 top-tier universities and institutions, this isn’t your average tech event. It’s a high-energy, collaborative playground where the brightest minds vibe, code, and push the boundaries of what’s possible. Let’s harness the power of AI and cook up the future together!

Flagship annual cross-universities entrepreneurship competition since 2015
Cumulated 9,000 students &
2,800 ideas

What is Hong Kong Techathon+?

01

Idea Spark

Join a team with fellow tech enthusiasts to ignite creativity and craft innovative solutions that make an impact.

02

Next‑Gen Trends

Explore emerging ideas and breakthroughs that are reshaping the tech landscape.

03

Accelerated Startup Journey

Step straight into HKSTP Ideation Programme with up to HK$100,000 seed support and parallel admission to university startup programmes.

Why should you join ?

01

Network and Grow

Engage with inspiring innovators worldwide, strengthen your circle of influence, and expand your professional network.

02

Build and Transform

Partner with fellow innovators to turn imagination into actionable solutions for tomorrow.

03

Empower and Evolve

Strengthen your skills, embrace challenges, and learn directly from industry mentors.

04

Showcase and Impress

Step onto the global stage, highlight your talents, and capture the attention of investors and tech leaders.

Join us in this dynamic arena where young techies from all backgrounds clash in a spirited competition, collaborate to innovate, and grow together. Are you ready to embrace the challenge and make your mark on the future? Hong Kong Techathon+ is the perfect platform for young entrepreneurs ready to shine and lead the next wave of technological advancements.

Hong Kong’s Premier International Intercollegiate Tech Event “Hong Kong Techathon+ 2025” Uniting Over 1,800 Global Tech Talent From Leading Local and Overseas Institutions
The annual flagship event in the innovation and technology (I&T) sector, the Hong Kong Techathon+ 2025, co-organised by the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation (HKSTP) and local higher education institutions was held on 17-19 January 2025.

Hong Kong Techathon+ 2024 (HK Techathon+ 2024), the highly anticipated academic spectacle in innovation and technology (I&T), jointly organised by the Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation (HKSTP) and ten co-organising universities, has successfully concluded with overwhelming support and applause.
